proposed_interpretation.purpose: Let operators connect inference engines and let applications discover and use those engines through a consistent API.
proposed_interpretation.standalone: A separately owned and installable product whose users do not need the Alch/DomainSpec development checkouts to run it.
proposed_interpretation.ownership: User decides Exchange scope; existing Alch, DomainSpec and Auth Foundation owners retain their respective language, compiler and identity contracts.

inherited_distinctions.caller: Requests inference through the public service contract.
inherited_distinctions.tenant: Existing authorization and request-isolation boundary; final standalone packaging scope remains to be confirmed.
